description.text: Needle lift, a stepper motor through a step and direction driver, with a limit switch at the top (home): a component of the Filling module, which carries out its skills
Filling pump; none is wired yet, so it has no outputs and dispensing is a time at the station's flow rate: a component of the Filling module, which carries out its skills
